name: Song 2
Song 2
note: 清單裡另一首、自選曲或自己寫的歌
Another listed song, own choice or own song
考試項目順序可以自己選,沒寫就照上表順序(p.48)
You may choose the order; otherwise as listed (p.48)
只看總分,不用每項都及格;沒有嘗試的項目是 0 分
Only the total counts; an item not attempted scores 0

text: Rock & Pop 沒有獨立的技巧項目:技巧在 Song 3(技巧重點曲)裡評,Technical control(技巧控制)滿分 12(Song 1、2 是 8);每首標了哪兩個技巧重點在曲本裡
Rock & Pop has no separate technical work: technique is marked in Song 3 (Technical control 12, Songs 1–2: 8); its two technical focuses are in the song book
Rock & Pop 沒有視奏項目;最接近的是 Session skills(臨場技能)的 Playback(有譜,可以看也可以不看)
Rock & Pop has no sight reading; the nearest is Session skills Playback (a chart you may read)
Rock & Pop 沒有聽力項目;Playback 就是聽一句、馬上打回來。官方配伴奏音軌,App 只有鼓和拍點
Rock & Pop has no aural test; Playback is listen-and-repeat. The exam uses a backing track; the App has drums and click only
數位考試沒有 Session skills,改成整體表現 20 分(演出與專注 10、音樂感知 10)
Digital exams have no Session skills; Overall performance 20 (delivery 10, awareness 10) instead
拿到沒看過的 song chart,看譜 30 秒(可以試打);播音軌,每一句聽完馬上打回來;開頭有 count-in,一直有伴奏;播兩次(練習、評分);照抄奏法與力度,不要變化
Unseen chart, 30 s to study (may try out); listen and repeat each phrase; count-in and backing throughout; 2 plays (practice, assessed); copy articulation and dynamics, no variation

legend: 每一級只列「新增」的要求;表上斜線的格子沿用前一級(官方:要求是累積的)
Each grade lists only new requirements; blank cells carry over (requirements are cumulative)

note: 官方寫 LT(Low Tom);App 用落地鼓的位置與聲音
Official: LT (low tom); the App uses the floor tom
速度、伴奏風格:參數表沒有這兩欄(查不到)
Tempo and backing style: not in the parameter table

text: 在沒聽過的伴奏上用指定風格即興;拿 chord chart,先聽一小段,30 秒看譜試打;伴奏播四遍後淡出;播兩次(練習、評分)。需要伴奏音軌,App 只列規格
Improvise in a given style over an unheard backing; chord chart, a short preview, 30 s to study; the loop plays 4 times and fades; 2 plays. Needs a backing track, so the App lists the spec only

legend: 每一級只列「新增」的要求;總小節數推論是循環的長度
Each grade lists only new requirements; total bars are taken as the loop length (inferred)

note: 官方只寫 Total bars;當作一次循環的長度(伴奏播四遍)是 App 的解讀
Official: total bars; reading it as one loop (played 4 times) is the App's assumption

harmony: 有時每小節 2 個和弦

styles: 任何常見風格(含混合風格)

legend: 自選曲參數表:官方說只是一般參考(general guide),技巧是累積的
Own-choice song parameters: a general guide only; techniques are cumulative

techniques: Cross stick、響弦開/關、短的記譜獨奏或過門、trashy/tight Hi-hat;五件式鼓、鼓棒
Cross stick, snares on/off, short notated solos/fills, trashy/tight hi-hat; 5-piece kit, sticks
同初級,加重音、斜線記譜(照風格自己打)/ cont. sim.(照前面繼續)
As Initial, plus accents, slash notation (play in style) / cont. sim. (carry on)
開/關 Hi-hat、含裝飾音 rudiment 的過門、很簡單的 swing;鼓刷(不刷圈)、hot rods
Open/closed hi-hat, fills with grace-note rudiments, very simple swing; brushes (no sweeps), hot rods

bpmText: Full range; may change in the song
techniques: 簡單的滾奏、Hi-hat 上雙手交替的 16-beat;軟槌
Simple rolls, 16-beat on hi-hat with alternating hands; soft mallets
幽靈音、鼓刷 scrub/swish、3 對 2
快速 Hi-hat 可能要用 Moeller/多重動作;圍繞樂句/合奏重音的獨奏;完整的鼓刷 swing
Fast hi-hat may need Moeller/multiple motions; solos around phrases and hits; full brush swing
更快的反彈大鼓、choked Hi-hat;可選雙踏
Faster rebound bass drum, choked hi-hat; optional double pedal
雙踏、Toms 上更快的雙擊滾奏、更多左手帶領
Double bass pedal; quicker tom double-stroke rolls; leading more with the left hand
加長的獨奏段、更難的雙踏、多樣的音色
Extended solos, harder double pedal, varied tones

practiceNote: 「去練」按鈕是 App 依類別對到技巧分頁;官方只寫類別,沒有指定是哪一個打法
Practice links are the App's mapping; the syllabus names a category, not a specific rudiment
